items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: At that time Jeannette McDonald, she was a big star, you know, she sang --

ctx.x: But let me tell you a little incident. This will kill you. So while I was in London in 1933, so Lord Beaverbrook, he's a Canadian, but he owns all the newspapers. You may have heard of him. He's big, big there. He would throw him a party so he throws this party at his mansion, you know, and
he had the guy that's married to the Queen now. He was just another turkey then, he wasn't married to her then. He hit the jackpot there.

So we don't have to carry no -- the guys carried their horns and didn't have to carry no bass and I didn't have to carry no drums. We play this party, Jack Hilton played till we got there. So we go in this party, we come in this party -- this is God's honest truth, this is not no illusion. This is the real thing. We come in this party and the place is crowded. At that time Jeannette McDonald, she was a big star, you know, she sang --
